microsoft/trellis-2.description: Convert a single image into a detailed, textured 3D mesh with Microsoft's Trellis-2. It exports a GLB with PBR materials at 512, 1024 or 1536 voxel resolution.

items.label: Input Image
items.note: Image to convert into a 3D mesh; background is automatically removed if no alpha channel is present

items.label: Resolution
items.note: 3D generation resolution: 512 (fastest), 1024 (recommended), 1536 (highest quality)

items.label: Seed
items.note: Random seed for reproducible results; 0 picks a random seed automatically

items.label: Texture Size
items.note: PBR texture map resolution in pixels for the GLB export

items.label: Decimation Target
items.note: Target face count for GLB mesh decimation; higher = more detail but larger file and slower xatlas UV unwrapping

items.label: Sparse Structure Steps
items.note: Diffusion steps for sparse structure (coarse 3D skeleton); more steps = better quality but slower

items.label: Sparse Structure Guidance Strength
items.note: CFG strength for sparse structure; higher = more faithful to input image but may cause artifacts

items.label: Sparse Structure Guidance Rescale
items.note: Corrects over-saturation from high CFG; 0 = off, 1 = full correction

items.label: Sparse Structure Rescale T
items.note: Timestep rescale for sparse structure; higher allocates more time to early (coarse) steps

items.label: Shape Slat Steps
items.note: Diffusion steps for detailed 3D geometry; directly affects shape detail quality

items.label: Shape Slat Strength
items.note: CFG strength for shape generation; controls how closely geometry follows the input image

items.label: Shape Slat Rescale
items.note: CFG rescale for shape; slightly lower than sparse structure for more natural geometry

items.label: Shape Slat Rescale T
items.note: Timestep rescale for shape generation; lower than sparse structure for more uniform step distribution

items.label: Tex Slat Steps
items.note: Diffusion steps for PBR texture generation; directly affects texture quality

items.label: Tex Slat Guidance Strength
items.note: CFG strength for texture; default 1.0 means no guidance (texture generation usually works best unguided)

items.label: Tex Slat Guidance Rescale
items.note: CFG rescale for texture; default 0 = off since guidance strength is already 1.0

items.label: Tex Slat Rescale T
items.note: Timestep rescale for texture generation

microsoft/trellis-2.title: Trellis-2 3D Mesh Generator

tencent/hy-world-2-0-world-reconstructio.description: Reconstruct a 3D scene from multi-view photos or a short video. Produces 3D Gaussian splats with depth maps and cameras, plus a colored point cloud.

items.label: Input Image
items.note: Image files for multi-view 3D reconstruction. Supported formats: .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .webp. Ignored if video is also provided.

items.label: Target Size
items.note: Maximum inference resolution along the longest image edge.

items.label: Input Video
items.note: Video file for video-based 3D reconstruction. Supported formats: .mp4, .avi, .mov, .webm, .gif. Takes priority over image. When both are set, video is used and image is ignored.

items.label: FPS
items.note: Frames per second to extract when input is a video and videoStrategy set to old. Higher FPS yields more frames per second of source video.

items.label: Video Strategy
items.note: Frame extraction strategy for video inputs. new = motion-aware (skips static frames), old = uniform sampling at the requested FPS.

items.label: Video Min Frames
items.note: Minimum number of frames to extract from a video input. Must be ≤ videoMaxFrames.

items.label: Video Max Frames
items.note: Maximum number of frames to extract from a video input.

items.label: Apply Sky Mask
items.note: When true, sky regions are filtered out of the Gaussian splats. Recommended for outdoor scenes; can be disabled for indoor scenes.

items.label: Apply Edge Mask
items.note: When true, points at depth/normal discontinuities (object edges) are filtered out for cleaner geometry.

items.label: Apply Confidence Mask
items.note: When true, the bottom 10% of points by model confidence are removed. Useful for very noisy inputs.

items.label: Sky Mask Source
items.note: Sky mask method. auto = ONNX + model fusion (strictest), model = WorldMirror 2.0's internal depth_mask only (no ONNX needed), onnx = skyseg.onnx alone.

items.label: Save Video
items.note: When true, renders a fly-through preview video from the generated 3D Gaussian Splats.

tencentarc/pixal3d.description: Pixal3D converts a single image into a textured 3D GLB mesh. It uses pixel-to-3D back-projection so geometry stays aligned to the input view.

items.label: Input Image
items.note: Image to convert into a 3D mesh; background is automatically removed if no alpha channel is present

items.label: Resolution
items.note: 3D generation resolution: 1024 (recommended), 1536 (highest quality)

items.label: Texture Size
items.note: PBR texture map resolution in pixels for the GLB export

items.label: Max Tokens
items.note: Maximum sparse tokens for the high-res cascade stage; higher = more detail

items.label: Seed
items.note: Random seed for reproducible results; 0 picks a random seed automatically

items.label: Decimation Target
items.note: Target mesh complexity for GLB export (approximate face budget); higher = more detail but larger file and slower UV unwrapping

items.label: Sparse Structure Sampling Steps
items.note: Diffusion steps for sparse structure (coarse 3D skeleton); more steps = better quality but slower

items.label: Sparse Structure Guidance Strength
items.note: CFG strength for sparse structure; higher = more faithful to input image but may cause artifacts

items.label: Sparse Structure Guidance Rescale
items.note: Corrects over-saturation from high CFG; 0 = off, 1 = full correction

items.label: Sparse Structure Rescale T
items.note: Timestep rescale for sparse structure; higher allocates more time to early (coarse) steps

items.label: Shape Slat Sampling Steps
items.note: Diffusion steps for detailed 3D geometry; directly affects shape detail quality

items.label: Shape Slat Guidance Strength
items.note: CFG strength for shape generation; controls how closely geometry follows the input image

items.label: Shape Slat Guidance Rescale
items.note: CFG rescale for shape; slightly lower than sparse structure for more natural geometry

items.label: Shape Slat Rescale T
items.note: Timestep rescale for shape generation; lower than sparse structure for more uniform step distribution

items.label: Tex Slat Sampling Steps
items.note: Diffusion steps for PBR texture generation; directly affects texture quality

items.label: Tex Slat Guidance Strength
items.note: CFG strength for texture; default 1.0 means no guidance (texture generation usually works best unguided)

items.label: Tex Slat Guidance Rescale
items.note: CFG rescale for texture; default 0 = off since guidance strength is already 1.0

items.label: Tex Slat Rescale T
items.note: Timestep rescale for texture generation
